needs.license: Select a license in ANT-OS to continue.
needs.project: Select a project in ANT-OS to continue.

shell.contextDescription: The OS pushes the current user, license, project and selection. Read it; never fetch it.
shell.toolbarDescription: This app set the OS title bar, enabled its search box and added a menu item.
shell.aboutMessage: Each tab demonstrates one platform capability.
shell.notificationsDescription: Toasts are shown by the OS, so they look the same in every app.
shell.notepadDescription: Open the OS side panel on a specific tab.
shell.appStateDescription: A string the OS keeps in the URL for you — it survives a reload or a shared link.
shell.navigateDescription: Ask the OS to navigate. The app never changes the top-level URL itself.

tables.title: Dynamic table
tables.description: Reads and writes the {table} table declared in app-config.json.

tasks.title: Open tasks
tasks.description: Click a task to open it in the notepad. Changes made anywhere appear here live.

files.title: Project files
files.description: Files in the root of the project's document management. Click a file to preview it.
files.empty: No files in the project root.

triggers.title: Run a trigger
triggers.description: The app only names the trigger. Credentials stay in the Vault and are added server-side.

signals.topicDescription: Publish on {topic}. Other apps on the topic receive it; the sender does not.
signals.splitDescription: Open another app next to this one.
